name: ps-script-root-scope-qualified
body: is_script_root accepts only $PSScriptRoot and ${PSScriptRoot} (case-insensitive), so a scope-qualified spelling such as $script:PSScriptRoot or ${script:PSScriptRoot} is Computed and its path stays unresolved. Limit: scope-qualified anchors are not recognised. Upgrade by accepting the script: scope qualifier when real scripts use it.
